name: Ably
tagline: Realtime messaging platform for pub/sub, presence, and IoT event fan-out
description: Ably provides a realtime messaging platform with REST and realtime APIs for pub/sub messaging, presence, history, and push notifications. It supports protocols including MQTT and WebSockets and is commonly used for IoT event fan-out, live updates, and multiplayer-style synchronization. Developers authenticate with API keys and can use official SDKs or the REST API directly.

auth.details: API key via HTTP Basic Auth (key name as username, key secret as password) or Authorization: Bearer; self-serve signup at ably.com

use_cases: publish a message to a realtime channel
retrieve message history for a channel
send MQTT-compatible IoT device events via REST
